concepts.name: 1 — Crown Sight
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original premium fantasy MMO targeting overlay icon for Highground, a World of Warcraft PvP addon. This is a visual design concept awaiting user selection, not an app screenshot.
Create ONE isolated icon on a genuinely transparent square background, centered with 12 percent empty padding. Straight-on orthographic view.
Highground visual language: sculpted blue-black steel (#111F30), luminous forged gold (#F4BB48), small ivory edge highlights (#FFE5AC), precise signal red (#FF626A). Contemporary, confident, exceptional game UI art direction. Broad clean silhouettes, restrained faceted metal relief, crisp edge separation and a dark outer edge to stay visible over gameplay. Readable when reduced to approximately 52 by 52 pixels, avoid fine filigree and tiny details.
The center and spaces between pieces must be fully transparent, so the enemy remains visible. No opaque background disk or square tile, no scene, no characters, no weapon illustration, no letters, no text, no labels, no watermark, no ruler marks, no scattered particles. No generic thin plus-sign crosshair with square corner brackets. No enormous glow haze.
Primary request: a completely new CIRCULAR sniper targeting sight, like a precision sight forged by a fantasy armorer.
Subject and silhouette: four substantial smoothly curved gold arc segments form a clean broken circular ring. The top segment has one subtle pointed summit peak integrated into its outer edge, echoing a gold crest. The left, right, and bottom segments each terminate in one short inward-pointing tapered tooth. Keep the central 60 percent open. A tiny bright red diamond is suspended at the exact center. The gold ring's broad front faces are luminous, its inner bevel is dark blue steel, its edge highlights are warm ivory. Compact symmetrical geometry with generous clear gaps between the four arcs; a simple unmistakable circular silhouette. Restrained metal shading; no decorative runes, gems, crown illustration, or secondary rings. A refined powerful sniper sight, not a large ornate emblem.
